summary: HomeStream is a TypeScript ESM pnpm monorepo for LAN media playback. Fastify 5 on Node 24 owns SQLite, TMDB metadata, AIOStreams discovery, FFmpeg/NVENC transcoding, a loopback ranged cache, optional TorBox caching and health workers. React 19/Vite provides browsing, always-visible navigation search, details with cast/recommendations, episode spoiler protection, HLS playback, Settings/About tabs and desktop renderer views. Electron 45 provides tray, supervision and a mini player with volume/mute. The shared package holds Zod schemas, IPC types, analytics, flags and sanitization. Dashboard tabs remain placeholders; no TV app source exists.
architecture: buildApp constructs services and routes; server main recovers orphans, opens loopback/public listeners, and starts health, downloads and mDNS. PlaybackManager coordinates session slots, source ranking, startup, encoders, recovery, HLS and subtitle extraction. A 201 session or 202 download-tracking result reaches the client. Proxy block caches, pacing and encoder lead gates bound reads. Web Query hooks validate schemas through the API client, startup defers work until Home content and idle, and SSE reconciles health/downloads. Desktop IPC is typed and allowlisted; the supervisor distinguishes attached from owned servers.
patterns: Strict TypeScript and explicit server .js imports; Zod contracts and thin routes; AppError envelopes with actionable hints; redacted logs/events/errors. Isolated offline tests use PORT=0, unique temp dirs and injected fakes; GPU/live are opt-in and must not run for documentation. No accounts, LAN only, always re-encode, streamId auto. Telemetry off without matching keys, manual/scrubbed/nonblocking, lazy web SDKs. File/function limits 400/80; grandfathered ceilings may only shrink. Additive details extras default to [] for older servers. Spoiler hiding is browser-local with blocked-storage fallback.
contributors: CODEOWNERS and origin/main history identify VeroxAUS as the only human contributor. Domain pages begin # Heading then Active contributors: VeroxAUS. Exclude bots. Omit maintainers.md for solo human ownership; no individual contribution metrics.
newFindings: TMDB details append credits or aggregate_credits, recommendations and similar; bounded cast/similar arrays default to empty for old payloads.
getLanAddresses filters virtual/link-local adapters only when physical candidates exist; mDNS uses that list.
Navigation search owns URL query/history, 300ms debounce and shortcuts; search route preload keeps initial navigation responsive.
Spoiler protection hides unfinished episode descriptions entirely and uses w92 stills, no CSS blur; settings preference is local only.
Settings now has accessible Settings/About tabs, device card and desktop integration, plus dynamic server information.
Mini-player volume/mute reuses player control state.
Wiki publish posts the no-reviewable-change summary on the merged wiki commit when GITHUB_TOKEN prevents workflow triggers.
docs/ideas and its HTML mockup are proposals, not implemented requirements.
